kept_lines: Indinero is a remote-first company, with ‘Dinerians’ working across 23+ states. We believe people do their best work where they are most productive, supporting a flexible work-from-home model that balances autonomy with the high security our clients’ financials demand. What brings us all together is a shared mission: helping businesses flourish.

Indinero provides outsourced accounting, bookkeeping, tax, and CFO services for growing businesses. A single integrated team of CPAs, Controllers, and financial advisors, backed by real-time accounting technology, handles everything from day-to-day bookkeeping to strategic financial planning.
